interpretation.candidate: flat_full is lowest total sampled raw event and lookup+output-transfer wall in both orders; parallel_full wins some individual batches
interpretation.query_authority: Each fresh capture uses original raw-derived measured local poses and exact unrounded original queries. Forward/reverse share byte-identical v2 trace. Initial v1 is separate provenance and is not treated as the same exact trajectory.
interpretation.coverage: 12x2048 retained real rows from accepted[8,12] and rejected[0,2], camera/fragment-union scopes and original0.12/0.06/0.03m ICP radii; four focused original-CPU tie/boundary/subnormal/unsupported cases
interpretation.new_shader_authority: Sampled original CPU nearest gold and same-family all-column uint64 parity for every warmup/repeat. New shaders do not yet have the full104m exact hit/miss shadow audit or whole-session proof.
interpretation.event_timer: GPU event brackets raw device lookup including output allocation and enqueue gaps; overlaps lookup wall and must not be added to it.
interpretation.disjoint_wall_timers: Dataset hash/tree/sort/upload includes selected null-stream sync; queryH2D; lookup enqueue+sync; following outputD2H; CPUresolution are separately reported. FreshCPUgold occurs once per batch, not once per variant.
interpretation.setup_limit: Base adapters compile original serial kernels even for replacement variants; baseline setup and replacement compile are separate; NVRTC cache differs between process orders.
interpretation.performance_limit: Totals are five repeats of bounded2048-query batches with9.5k–14.6k target clouds. No component, Finish, liveFPS, production acceleration or extrapolated win claim. Original full-grid bridge needs roughly3.13x search gain to match native on prior all9 timing; these1.62–1.70x raw-event gains do not establish that.
interpretation.next_measurement: Best next shader candidate is flat_full, but full fresh accepted/rejected CPU hit+miss audits and original gates must pass before any all-in speed conclusion.

domain.cell_width: smallest power of two >=radius; reversible finite ldexp scaling
domain.packing: bias each axis by1048576; x<<42|y<<21|z, no collisions in declared domain
domain.enclosure: CPU strict squared-distance hit implies every absolute coordinate difference<cell_width; at most one floor cell apart
domain.distance: original float64 points; explicit RN subtraction, multiply and left-associated add; --fmad=false; CuPy injects -ftz=true for single precision only
domain.uncertainty: 64epsilon relative metric margin for nearest/second/radius; CPU ties and boundary/unsupported fallback
domain.missing_policy: original CPU tree unless explicitly research-certified and CPU hit/miss proof bound to helper/source/kernel/input

cache_policy.limit: Retained grid arrays only; transient launch/transfer buffers and CuPy pools separately observed

cupy_injected_compiler_options: -ftz=true; single precision only; original geometry is explicit FP64
